title: Ombudsman suspends Laguna town treasurer for lapses in securing ballot boxes

blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman has suspended Santa Maria, Laguna Municipal Treasurer Ma. Theresa Lontok for a month and a day without pay in an administrative case for alleged lapses in securing ballot boxes from the 2022 elections.
